verified_facts.text: The resort sits at the top of the cliffs of Falésia on the Algarve coast, with views over the Atlantic Ocean.
verified_facts.excerpt: Located at the top of the cliffs of Falésia in the Algarve's coast, the resort's iconic location offers a unique setting with breathtaking views over the Atlantic Ocean.

verified_facts.text: Pine Cliffs Hotel is at the heart of Pine Cliffs Resort, a five-minute walk from the beach.
verified_facts.excerpt: placing guests just a five-minute walk from the beach and the resort's celebrated restaurants, wellness and leisure facilities

verified_facts.text: The hotel's architecture is inspired by the region's heritage and has Moorish influences.
verified_facts.excerpt: With distinctive architecture inspired by the region’s rich heritage and elegant Moorish influences

verified_facts.text: The hotel is traditionally styled, with Portuguese history told through murals and hand-painted tiles.
verified_facts.excerpt: traditionally styled with indigenous design, where Portuguese history is narrated through murals and hand painted tiles, skillfully complemented by native architecture

verified_facts.text: Headboards, bathrooms, internal courtyards and fountains are decorated with local Portuguese tiles in a blue, white and yellow color scheme.
verified_facts.excerpt: The design there is strongly informed by local Portuguese tiles, which makes for a very pretty blue, white, and yellow color scheme. Headboards for every bed are decorated in these tiles, as are bathrooms, internal courtyards, and fountains.

verified_facts.text: The rooms blend original Portuguese tiles with contemporary design.
verified_facts.excerpt: seamlessly blend original Portuguese tiles with contemporary design, reflecting Moorish heritage with a modern twist

verified_facts.text: Rooms and suites look out over the Albufeira coast, the Atlantic Ocean or the gardens.
verified_facts.excerpt: offers breathtaking views of the Albufeira coast, the Atlantic Ocean, or our exquisite gardens

verified_facts.text: Rooms have authentic terracotta-tiled floors.
verified_facts.excerpt: Our luxury hotel rooms in Albufeira feature authentic terracotta-tiled floors

verified_facts.text: The Pine Cliffs Golf Course is a 9-hole course designed by Martin Hawtree, perched above the Atlantic.
verified_facts.excerpt: An impeccably maintained, superb 9-hole course perched 200 feet above the crystal-clear waters of the Atlantic. Designed by architect Martin Hawtree

verified_facts.text: The course's signature Par 3 sixth hole, the Devil's Parlour, requires a carrying shot over the cliffs above a ravine.
verified_facts.excerpt: the real highlight is the Par 3 sixth hole, known as the Devil’s Parlour. This thrilling hole features a 197-metre carrying shot over the cliffs, overlooking a ravine.

verified_facts.text: Mirador Champagne Bar sits at the edge of the cliffs, serving champagne and cocktails.
verified_facts.excerpt: toasted with exceptional champagne drinks and cocktails at the breathtaking Mirador Champagne Bar just at the edge of the cliffs

verified_facts.text: The Serenity Spa's signature treatment uses Algarve ingredients such as fleur-de-sel from Ria Formosa, sand from Falésia Beach, carob and orange oil.
verified_facts.excerpt: Discover our Signature Treatment with the most traditional ingredients of the Algarve, like fleur-de-sel from Ria Formosa, sand from Falésia Beach, carob and orange oil.

verified_facts.text: The spa's thermal oasis includes an indoor hydro pool, herbal sauna, salt sauna, ice fountain and experience showers.
verified_facts.excerpt: Enjoy our indoor hydro pool, herbal sauna, salt sauna, ice fountain, experience showers and many other treatments.

verified_facts.text: Access to the spa's thermal oasis is not complimentary.
verified_facts.excerpt: Access to this area is not complimentary.

verified_facts.text: Outdoor pools are set among the hotel gardens, and the main pool has cliff-top views along the coast.
verified_facts.excerpt: outdoor swimming pools nestled amongst the hotel gardens, guests are welcome to choose the ambiance that best suits their mood. The main pool offers breathtaking cliff-top views following the beautiful Algarvian coast.

verified_facts.text: The Annabel Croft Tennis Academy has floodlit clay and all-weather hard courts on the hotel grounds.
verified_facts.excerpt: The Annabel Croft Tennis Academy features five floodlit courts—two clay and three all-weather hard courts—ideal for day or nighttime play. Located on the beautifully landscaped grounds of the Pine Cliffs Hotel

verified_facts.text: The Porto Pirata kids' club has life-size pirate ships, a children's pool and an 18-hole mini-golf course.
verified_facts.excerpt: Explore our Porto Pirata kids' club with life-size pirate ships at Pine Cliffs. Supervised fun with bouncing castle, basketball court, mini track for big-wheel toys, trampoline, a swimming pool just for kids, and an 18-hole mini-golf course

verified_facts.text: The Head Concierge leads a weekly historical walk to see the hand-painted azulejo tiles decorating the resort.
verified_facts.excerpt: Discover the magnificence of the Azulejos, treasured hand-painted Portuguese tiles that charmingly decorate the Pine Cliffs Resort. Our guests can follow Head Concierge on his weekly tour and go on a historical walk

verified_facts.text: The concierges wear the Les Clefs d'Or insignia.
verified_facts.excerpt: proudly wearing "Les Clefs d'Or", the gilt insignia of the celebrated international concierge society

verified_facts.text: Maré is a beach restaurant steps from the ocean, serving freshly caught fish and seafood.
verified_facts.excerpt: Steps from the ocean, Maré is a contemporary beach restaurant where the flavours of the Atlantic take centre stage, with freshly caught fish and seafood

verified_facts.text: O Pescador serves grilled fish and Algarve classics such as cataplana and seafood rice.
verified_facts.excerpt: O Pescador celebrates the Atlantic with freshly grilled fish, seafood specialties and regional classics such as cataplana and seafood rice

verified_facts.text: Restaurants and bars are subject to seasonal opening.
verified_facts.excerpt: Restaurants and bars are subject to seasonal opening

verified_facts.text: Condé Nast Traveler advises booking the smarter restaurants at least a couple of days in advance.
verified_facts.excerpt: you need to book at least a couple of days in advance if you want to score a table at one of the smarter restaurants

verified_facts.text: The resort is large, and Condé Nast Traveler says its size can take some getting used to.
verified_facts.excerpt: The size can take some getting used to
